current.text: Peyton Watson has left Denver. DeMar DeRozan has joined the team.
David Adelman sets the rotation. How the new pieces fit together is the main open question.
The projected starters are Jamal Murray, Christian Braun, Cam Johnson, Aaron Gordon and Nikola Jokic.
The projected bench is DeMar DeRozan, Spencer Jones, Marvin Bagley, Tyus Jones and Julian Strawther. DeRozan comes off the bench.
The depth behind Aaron Gordon at power forward is very weak.
The team is mostly healthy going into the season.
Losing Tim Hardaway Jr. leaves Denver short on spacing. They need shooters who will take the open shots that Jokic's gravity creates.
The schedule is good. Denver plays 43 games through March 28, one below the most of any team. It has 14 back-to-backs, which ranks 12 of 30 (1 = fewest).
Denver has one of only three five-game weeks this season.
The fantasy playoff schedule is strong. Denver plays 11 games in weeks 19 to 21, which ranks 4 of 30. There is one back-to-back in week 20 and one in week 21.
Denver is a strong team, with a win total of 49.5 (rank 6). The risk of tanking or late-season shutdowns is low.
Moore predicts 50 wins and a weaker team than last season.
Moore doubts the team will rest Gordon, Murray and Jokic on purpose.
The roster is unsettled. Cam Johnson or Christian Braun could be traded.
Moore doubts ownership will pay the luxury tax. He expects at least two of last year's starters, Cam Johnson among them, to be gone by the trade deadline.
Do not take Zeke Nnaji early just because he plays next to Jokic. Jamal Murray is a fine pick in that range.

durable.text: Backup centers in Denver do not produce. Bigs who look fine on other teams tend to fall apart once they arrive.
The hosts have concerns about the Nuggets training staff because of the team's injury history.

note: Denver is a strong team with a top-4 playoff schedule (11 games) and little planned rest, which helps Jokic, Murray and Gordon. Backup bigs like Nnaji and Bagley rarely produce here, so do not reach for them, and the depth behind Gordon is weak. Watch early how Adelman uses DeRozan off the bench, and watch for trades involving Cam Johnson or Christian Braun before the deadline.
